name: aectl
description: Drive Adobe After Effects from the shell or an AI agent: lint + run ExtendScript as one undo step, dump comps, render frames to contact sheets.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/ae.mjs --legal-comments=none "--banner:js=// Generated from src/ by pnpm build. Do not edit."
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && git diff --exit-code dist/

author: thdctrt
